defs.def: the normal order and way in which you regularly do things 常规；正常顺序

ex.s: Slowly but surely, my efforts to adjust to the new routine paid off.
ex.t: 我努力适应新作息，缓慢但稳步地见到了成效。

ex.s: Doing the same routine all the time.
ex.t: 一直做同样的常规训练。

ex.s: These elements are called the cue, the routine, and the reward.
ex.t: 这些要素被称为提示、常规和奖励。

ex.s: While a routine involves repeated behaviour, it’s not necessarily performed in response to a deep﹣rooted urge, as a habit is.
ex.t: 虽然常规包含重复行为，但它未必像习惯那样是出于根深蒂固的冲动而做出的。

ex.s: But the study was small and needs to be repeated with far larger groups of people to determine exactly which aspects of an exercise routine make the biggest difference.
ex.t: 但这项研究规模小，需要用大得多的人群重复，以确切确定锻炼计划的哪些方面影响最大。

ex.s: 54    Sometimes even routine occurrences become sources of pre-anger, or anger itself.
ex.t: 54 有时，即使是日常琐事也会成为前愤怒或愤怒本身的源头。

ex.s: In what way is a routine different from a habit?
ex.t: 常规与习惯在哪些方面不同？

ex.s: Supposedly you can do it in two hours, but we stopped at the different gates and ___49___ (watchtower) to fake pictures or just to watch the local people going about their ____50____ (day) routines.
ex.t: 据说你两小时就能走完，但我们在不同的门和____49____（watchtower）停下拍照，或只是看当地人进行他们____50____（day）的日常。

defs.def: a situation in which life is boring because things are always done in the same way 生活乏味；无聊
a series of movements, jokes, etc. that are part of a performance （演出中的）一套动作，一系列笑话（等）
a list of instructions that enable a computer to perform a particular task 例行程序；例程
done or happening as a normal part of a particular job, situation or process 常规的；例行公事的；日常的

ex.s: Involve your child in the daily running of the house: tidying toys, feeding the dog, watering the plants. ____36____ When the tasks become as routine as brushing teeth, kids internalise that helping with housework is simply part of life.
ex.t: 让孩子参与家里的日常运转：整理玩具、喂狗、给植物浇水。____36____ 当这些任务变得像刷牙一样例行，孩子们就会内化“帮忙做家务就是生活的一部分”。

ex.s: ● Make housework part of the family routine.
ex.t: ● 让家务成为家庭日常的一部分。

ex.s: The boats drive them away from the places where they feed and interrupt their routine of resting and taking care of their young.
ex.t: 船只把它们从觅食的地方赶走，打扰了它们休息和照顾幼崽的日常。

ex.s: Most importantly, instead of disrupting these animals’ routines, we should try to adapt to them.
ex.t: 最重要的是，我们不应打扰这些动物的日常，而应该试着去适应它们。

Emma spent an hour with me in the staff room talking me through the daily routine.
ex.t: 埃玛在教员休息室花了一个小时陪我梳理了日常的例行安排。

ex.s: Your home will also learn your daily routine and preferences, so everything will be ready for you when you get home each evening.
ex.t: 你的家还会学习你的日常作息和偏好，这样每天晚上你回到家时一切都会为你准备好。

defs.def: not unusual or different in any way 平常的；正常的；毫不特别的
ordinary and boring 乏味的；平淡的
